name: Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award
benefit:
- In this scheme every year ₹51000/- is awarded with the shawl and certificate to the farmer who gains the first position in each category and also first five farmers from each category are appreciated with the shawl &amp; certificate.
- In addition to this, farmers as in the form of encouragement are appreciated by giving shawls &amp; certificates for the special work done in the field of
_eligibility_text:
1. The farmer should be a permanent resident of Gujarat State.
1. The farmers either Male or Female who possesses Agriculture land in Gujarat are eligible to apply for this scheme.
